senses.gloss: मधु- + आसव मधु- + आसव, m. a spirit distilled from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia.
मधु- + कोश मधु- + कोश, m. the honeycomb or hive.
मधु- + क्रम मधु- + क्रम, m. 1. tippling. 2. the honeycomb.
मध्य- + देश मध्य- + देश, m. the middle region, a part of India, Man. 2, 21.
मध्यम- + भृतक मध्यम- + भृतक, m. a husbandman.
मधु- + मक्षिका मधु- + मक्षिका, f. a bee.
मधु- + मथन मधु- + मथन, m. the destroyer of Madhu, a name of Viṣṇu, Lass. 71, 6; Bhāg. P. 6, 9, 38 (Burnouf, ‘qui produis le nectar’).

मधु मधु,
 I. adj. Sweet, Chr. 291, 6 = Rigv. i. 85, 6; Megh, 67.
 II. m.
 1. Liquorice.
 2. A tree, Bassia latifolia.
 3. The month Caitra, March--April, Ṛt. 6, 24.
 4. The [] season of spring, Mālav. d. 26.
 5. The name of a Daitya slain by Viṣṇu; cf. मधुभिद्.
 III. n.
 1. Honey, Hit. i. d. 81, M.M.
 2. The nectar of flowers.
 3. Milk.
 4. Sugar.
 5. Spirituous liquor from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia, or wine, Megh. 93; Ragh. 4, 60.
 6. Water.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. μέθυ; O.H.G. medu, mito; A.S. medu, medo.

मधुक मधु + क,
 I. adj. Sweet.
 II. m. A bard.
 III. m. and n. Liquorice.
 IV. n. Tin.
मधूक मधूक, derived from मधु, m. A tree, Bassia latifolia, Kathās. 7, 14.

माधूक माधूक (from मधु and मधूक), adj.
 1. Sweet-voiced, Man. 10, 33.
 2. Made of the Bassia tree.

मधुकर मधु-कर,
 I. m.
 1. A bee, Vikr. d. 105.
 2. A lover.
 II. f. री, A bee, Pañc. ii. d. 158.
मधुकरिका मधुकरिका, i. e. मधुकर + क, f. A proper name, Śāk. 77, 16 (Prākṛ.).
मधुकृत् मधु-कृ + त्, and मधुद्रु मधु-द्रु, and मधुप मधु-प (vb. 1. पा), m. A bee, Pañc. i. d. 419 (प).
मधुच्युत् मधु-च्यु + त्, adj. Distilling honey, Utt. Rāmac. 69, 4.
मधुपर्क मधु-पर्क, i. e. मधु-पृच् + अ, m. A dish of curds, honey, and clarified butter, Man. 3, 119; Chr. 16, 19.
मधुभिद् मधु-भिद्, m. Viṣṇu (see मधु), Pañc. v. d. 28.
मधुमन्त् मधु + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Sweet, Chr. 296, 9 = Rigv. i. 112, 9.
मधुमय मधु + मय, adj., f. यी, Sweet, Hit. ii. d. 154; luscious.

मधुर मधु + र,
 I. adj.
 1. Sweet (figuratively), Pañc. ii. d. 65.
 2. Agreeable, Pañc. 248, 11.
 3. Tender, [] Daśak. in Chr. 201, 13.
 II. ˚रम्. adv. Sweetly, in an agreeable manner, Chr. 17, 21.
 III. m. Sweetness.
 IV. f. रा.
 1. Marrow.
 2. The name of a town, Utt. Rāmac. 176, 8.
 3. The name of several plants.
 V. n.
 1. Treacle.
 2. Poison.
 3. Tin.
 --Comp.

माधुर माधुर, i. e. मधुर + अ,
 I. n. Arabian jasmine.
 II. f. री, Spirituous liquor; see माधुर्य.
मधुरता मधुर + ता, f. Sweetness, figurat., Pañc. v. d. 83; gracefulness, Pañc. v. d. 2.
मधुल मधुल (for मधुर), n. Spirituous liquor.
मधुलिह् मधु-लिह्, m. A bee, Vikr. d. 130.
मधूपघ्न मधूपघ्न, i. e. मधु-उपघ्न, n. A name of the town Mathurā.

मधूलक मधूलक, derived from मधु,
 I. adj. Sweet.
 II. m.
 1. Sweetness.
 2. A sort of Bassia latifolia.

मध्य म + ध्य (म is an old pronoun),
 I. adj.
 1. Middle, Rājat. 5, 313.
 2. Middle-sized, Man. 8, 134; of middle sort, Bhartṛ. 2, 73.
 3. Intermediate; amongst.
 4. Right, proper.
 5. Low.
 II. m. and n.
 1. The middle, Vikr. d. 6; the centre, abl. amongst, Pañc. 253, 14; at the end of comp. In, Pañc. 10, 5 (नगर-मध्य + म्, in the town).
 2. The waist. Vikr d. 129.
 III. m. Cessation, interval.
 IV. f. या.
 1. A young woman, a girl arrived at puberty.
 2. The middle finger.
 V. n.
 1. A horse's flank.
 2. A very large number.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. medius; Goth. midja; A.S. midd, ge-midlian; Goth. -missô, missa-; A.S. mis-; O.H.G. missa, missi, mis-; μέσος.
माध्य माध्य, i. e. मध्य + अ, adj., f. या, and माध्यम माध्यम, i. e. मध्यम + अ, adj., f. मी, Middle.

मध्यग मध्य-ग, adj.
 1. Who or what goes in the centre or amongst.
 2. Existing in, Pañc. iii. d. 205.
 --Comp.
मध्यतस् मध्य + तस्, adv. From or in the middle, Hiḍ. 1, 21.

मध्यन्दिन मध्यन्दिन, i. e. मध्य + म्-दिन, n. Noon, Pañc. 82, 1.
 --Comp.

मध्यम मध्य + म,
 I. adj.
 1. Middle, Vikr. d. 19.
 2. Of middle sort, Hit. ii. d. 69; of moderate strength.
 3. Middle born, neither the oldest nor youngest, Chr. 4, 11.
 II. m. and n. The waist, Nal. 1, 10.
 III. m.
 1. The fifth note of the Hindu gamut.
 2. One of the scales.
 3. The middle country (= मध्य-देश).
 4. A sort of deer.
 IV. f. मा, A girl arrived at puberty.
 2. The middle finger.
 3. A central blossom.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. A.S. medeme.

मध्यस्थ मध्य-स्थ,
 I. adj.
 1. Middle.
 2. Living in the midst (of persons), Pañc. 191, 10.
 3. Neutral, Man. 9, 272.
 4. Impartial, Mālav. 9, 2.
 5. Indifferent, Śāk. 63, 19.
 II. m. A mediator, a judge, Lass. 92, 3.

माध्यस्थ माध्यस्थ, i. e. मध्यस्थ + अ, n.
 1. Middle state.
 2. Indifference to earthly objects, Man. 4, 257.
मध्येपृष्ठम् मध्येपृष्ठम्, i. e. मध्य + इ-पृष्ठ + म्, adv. On the back, Bhartṛ. 2, 28.
मध्वल मध्वल, i. e. मधु + वल m. Tippling.
मध्वासवनिक मध्वासवनिक, i. e. [] मधु-आ-सु + अन + इक, m. A distiller.
मध्विजा मध्विजा, probably मधु + इ-ज (an anomal. loc.), f. Spirituous liquor.
मधु-मल्ली मधु-मल्ली, f. double jasmine.
मधु- + मस्तक मधु- + मस्तक, n. a sweetmeat made of flour, honey, oil, and butter (cf. मस्तु),

माधव माधव, i. e. मधु + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Made of honey.
 2. Belonging to the spring, Vikr. d. 23 (cf. Sch.).
 II. m.
 1. Viṣṇu, Pañc. i. d. 238.
 2. The month Vaiśākha.
 3. Spring.
 III. f. वी.
 1. Sugar, clayed or candied.
 2. Spirituous liquor.
 3. Durgā.
 4. A large creeper, Gaertnera racemosa, Megh. 76.
 5. A bawd.
 IV. n. Sweetness.
 --Comp.
माधवसेनाराजन् माधव-सेना-राजन्, m. A proper name. Daśak. in Chr. 191, 2.
माधुपर्किक माधुपर्किक, i. e. मधुपर्क + इक, adj. Presented as a token of respect to a guest, Man. 9, 206.
माधुमत माधुमत, m. pl. The people of Kashmir.

माधुर्य माधुर्य, i. e. मधुर + य, n., and f. री.
 1. Sweetness, Bhartṛ. 2, 6.
 2. [] Gracefulness, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 14.
 --Comp.

माध्यस्थ्य माध्यस्थ्य, i. e. मध्यस्थ + य, n.
 1. Mediation.
 2. Office of an arbiter, Lass. 92, 4.
माध्वक माध्वक, i. e. मधु + अ + क (anomal.), n. Spirit distilled from the flowers of the Bassia.

माध्वी माध्वी, i. e. मधु + अ + ई (anomal.), f.
 1. Spirituous liquor distilled from the flowers of the Bassia, Man. 11, 94.
 2. A sort of fish.

माध्वीक माध्वी + क, n.
 1. Spirituous liquor made from the Bassia.
 2. Wine.
मधु- + वर्ण मधु- + वर्ण, adj. sweet, like honey, Chr. 293, 2 = Rigv. i. 87, 2.
मधु- + वार मधु- + वार, m. drinking repeatedly.
मधु- + व्रत मधु- + व्रत, m. a bee.
मध्यम- + संग्रह मध्यम- + संग्रह, m. intriguing with another man's wife.
मधुर-संभाष मधुर-संभाष, adj. discoursing agreeably, Chr. 53, 2.
मधु- + सहाय मधु- + सहाय, m. Kāmadeva, the god of love.
मधु- + सारथि मधु- + सारथि, m. Kāmadeva, the god of love.
मधु- + सिक्थक मधु- + सिक्थक, n. a sort of poison.
मधु- + सूदन मधु- + सूदन, m. Viṣṇu.
मधु-सु- + हृद् मधु-सु- + हृद्, m. Kāmadeva.
